question: Arvind Parikh is associated with which of the following musical instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sitar.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arvind Parikh** is a** renowned sitar player** and has been associated with the instrument for several decades.
 
• He has performed at various prestigious events and has received several accolades for his contributions to** Indian classical music.**
 
• The sitar is a** stringed instrument,** which is commonly used in** North Indian classical music** and is known for its unique sound and intricate playing techniques.
 
• Arvind Parikh is considered one of the **leading sitar players** in India and has trained many students in the art of playing this instrument.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shehnai** is a **wind instrument.**

 
 
• It is commonly used in** North Indian classical music.**
 
 
 
• **Mridangam** is a** percussion** instrument.
 
 
• It is commonly used in the **Carnatic music of South India.**
 
 
 
• **Tabla** is a pair of **drums.**
 
 
• It is commonly used in **North Indian classical music.**
